about.title: East Palo Alto Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: East Palo Alto residents rely on countless everyday products, from household appliances to vehicle parts and machinery used near the US-101 corridor and local warehouses along E Bayshore Road. When one of those products fails because of a design flaw, a manufacturing error, or a missing warning, the resulting injury can upend a family's routine in this San Mateo County community of nearly 30,000 people. California law generally allows an injured person to pursue a strict liability claim without having to prove the manufacturer was careless, which can make these cases more approachable than other injury claims. We handle product liability claims directly and can review the details, explain your options, and help preserve important evidence like the product itself. There's no cost for a free consultation, and no obligation to move forward.

Lacerations from broken or malfunctioning tools

whyChoose.title: Why East Palo Alto Residents Choose Us

items.title: Strict Liability Can Simplify Your Path
items.desc: California often allows product liability claims to proceed under strict liability, meaning the focus is on whether the product was defective and caused harm, not on proving the manufacturer was negligent.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable, which may open more than one avenue for pursuing a claim.

items.title: Guidance on Preserving the Product
items.desc: We can advise you on keeping the defective product intact and unaltered, since it often serves as key evidence in showing how the defect caused your injury.

items.question: Do I need to prove the manufacturer was negligent?
items.answer: Not necessarily. California product liability claims often rely on strict liability, which generally requires showing the product was defective and that the defect caused your injury, rather than proving carelessness on the manufacturer's part. We can walk you through which theory fits your situation.

items.question: What should I do with the product that hurt me?
items.answer: Try to keep it in the same condition it was in when the injury happened, without repairing, discarding, or altering it. This applies whether the incident happened at home, near a busy stretch like University Avenue, or anywhere else in East Palo Alto, since the product itself is often central evidence.

items.question: Does this service charge anything?
items.answer: No. We provide a free consultation to injured people in East Palo Alto. We typically work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation.

items.question: How long do I have to bring a claim?
items.answer: California has specific time limits for product liability claims, and waiting too long can affect your options. Because deadlines depend on the details of your case, it's worth speaking with us sooner rather than later.
